messages:
Alex (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread for the questions we didn't get to in the AH. I'll drop the answers we promised and a short owners list.
Maria P. (Product): Appreciate it Alex. Two asks we flagged: Dedicated GA date and Private deployment rollout window.
Alex (CEO): Dedicated GA target: late Q2 (aiming for the week of 2026-06-22). That's firming up but subject to final SRE signoff.
Sam R. (Eng): To be explicit — SRE signoff criteria: 99.95% regional uptime on our smoke tests, burst autoscale verified with 2x expected production load, and no critical perf regressions in the last 2 weeks. I'm owning verification. See infra ticket: INFR-2345.
Lina V. (Solutions): For customers asking about Private onboarding (VPC + KMS), we expect a rolling schedule starting July, with first pilots in early July. I'll coordinate partner invites.
Jordan T. (PM): Question from the ops team: will we support customer-managed identity (SAML + SCIM) at GA or post-GA?
Maria P. (Product): SAML will be supported at GA; SCIM user provisioning will be in the follow-up GA+1 patch (ETA ~6 weeks post-GA). I'll update the product docs.
Alex (CEO): On pricing: no surprise large changes at GA. We'll publish clear Dedicated tiers and a migration guide for hosted customers. Finance will publish examples for 3 common workloads. Owner: Maria.
Sam R. (Eng): Quick note about routing fallbacks — we will auto-failover to a lower-capacity model variant if Dedicated capacity is exhausted (configurable per-customer). This is implemented as a policy in router v2; test plan is in ENG-ops-runbook.md (link: https://redwood/internal/eng/runbooks/router-v2).
Lina V. (Solutions): Customer ask — can we guarantee model version pinning during rollouts? Answer: yes, customers can pin exact model sha; rollouts default to canary then global. I'll draft a short prompt template and internal playbook. Owner: Lina.
Jordan T. (PM): Action item to create a one-pager for sales about GA capabilities + limits. Owner: Jordan. Due: 2026-06-15.
Alex (CEO): Open question from Q/A about multi-region latency SLAs: short answer — not at initial GA, but we're working on region-to-region orchestration for H2.
Maria P. (Product): Followup: we promised an examples repo for cost/perf tuning (batching, cache, quantization). I'll upload a sample app and a benchmark script to https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples by next Tuesday.
Sam R. (Eng): FYI for eng leads — I'll send a cross-team checklist for the final release week: smoke tests, perf baselines, canary ramp steps, rollback playbook. Expect calendar invite.
Lina V. (Solutions): One last customer ops ask — will we include audit logs for Private? Yes, KMS/HSM integration + audit logging included. I'll attach sample audit schema in the partner doc.
Jordan T. (PM): Quick logistics Q: are there recording + slides? Alex, you said you'd share.
Alex (CEO): Slides and recording: https://redwood/slides/ah-2026-05 and https://redwood/recordings/ah-2026-05.
deploy-bot: Reminder — follow-up checklist created: RB-763 (kanban card).
Alex (CEO): TL;DR action owners: Sam -> SRE signoff & smoke tests (INFR-2345), Maria -> pricing + examples repo, Lina -> Private partner schedule + audit schema, Jordan -> sales one-pager. If anything else missing, reply here and we'll slot it. :thumbsup:
Maria P. (Product): Added owners to the internal GH project and linked slides. I'll ping legal about the Dedicated terms draft.
Sam R. (Eng): Noted. I'll post a short status update in #eng-sre by EOD Friday.
Lina V. (Solutions): I'll start reaching out to pilot customers tomorrow.
Jordan T. (PM): Putting the sales one-pager draft in Google and will solicit comments.
Alex (CEO): Thanks team. If you were at AH and asked a question that didn't get answered, drop it here and we'll follow up.
